Papa & Barkley’s patches contain whole-plant, solventless cannabis oil, and are made with our signature solventless, chemical-free infusion process to preserve the plant’s full spectrum of cannabinoids, terpenes and phytonutrients for maximum therapeutic benefits. Apply Releaf Patches to areas with prominent veins to improve transdermal efficacy, such as the backs of knees or inside of wrists.
